name: Floor One: The Homecoming
description: Expanded Floor One: The Homecoming campaign pack with core route plus Coliseum, County Jail, Personal Home, Memory Lanes, and Last Stand Sporting & Arms optional locations.

records.name: Reinforced Work Gloves
records.system_description: Heavy work gloves with System-reinforced knuckles.

mechanics.notes: +1 STR while equipped. Built for lifting, prying, and hitting things that deserve it.

records.name: Mall Security Vest
records.system_description: A stab-resistant vest with an aggressively official SECURITY patch.

mechanics.notes: +1 CON while equipped.

records.name: Wrong-Way Track Shoes
records.system_description: Running shoes whose arrows point backward.

mechanics.notes: +1 DEX while equipped.

records.name: Inventory Reading Glasses
records.system_description: Cheap readers that sharpen details the System thinks you missed.

mechanics.notes: +1 INT while equipped.

records.name: Customer Service Smile Pin
records.system_description: A red enamel smile that is somehow judging you.

mechanics.notes: +1 CHA while equipped.

records.name: Red Pry Bar
records.system_description: A solid demolition bar.

mechanics.notes: Reliable improvised melee tool; also useful for forcing doors and crates.

records.name: Roadside Tire Iron
records.system_description: Heavy, ugly, effective.

mechanics.notes: Melee weapon and leverage tool.

records.name: Industrial Flashlight
records.system_description: A dented LED flashlight with a magnetic base.

mechanics.notes: Bright directional light; useful for signaling and searching.

records.name: Handheld Radio Pair
records.system_description: Two rugged radios that still work inside most of the false town.

mechanics.notes: Campaign utility item; local short-range voice communication.

records.name: Emergency Med Pouch
records.system_description: A compact pouch of dungeon-approved medical supplies.

mechanics.notes: Consumable narrative medical supplies; does not replace the Heal spell.

records.name: Wrong Dog Whistle
records.system_description: A whistle audible to things that insist they are dogs.

mechanics.notes: Campaign key/tool. Can distract or attract Wrong Dogs when the GM determines it applies.

records.name: The Black Key
records.system_description: A matte-black key that refuses to reflect light.

mechanics.notes: Quest item. Opens the black service door on the Stadium route.

records.name: Coach's Whistle
records.system_description: A shrill whistle recovered from the school anomaly.

mechanics.notes: +1 CHA while equipped; campaign hooks may react to it.

records.name: Battery Bandolier
records.system_description: A belt of mismatched batteries that are always the size you need.

mechanics.notes: +1 INT while equipped.

records.name: Hometown Jacket
records.system_description: A varsity jacket with the wrong year stitched into every patch.

mechanics.notes: +1 CON while equipped.

records.name: Pump Seven Token
records.system_description: A brass token stamped PUMP 7 / ONE USE ONLY.

mechanics.notes: Anomaly-site quest item.

records.name: Locker 113 Key
records.system_description: A school locker key labeled 113 in fresh black marker.

mechanics.notes: Anomaly-site quest item.

records.name: Impossible Receipt
records.system_description: A receipt listing purchases one of the crawlers remembers but never made.

mechanics.notes: Anomaly evidence; no direct mechanical bonus.

records.name: Ms. Bell
records.personality: Dry, impatient, competent, and protective once the crawlers prove they listen.
secrets: Knows the town is assembled from crawler memories, not copied perfectly.
Has seen the black door appear only after anomaly evidence is collected.

records.name: Deputy Vale
records.personality: Polite in the way a locked door is polite.
secrets: Collects information on crawler movement for the local Borough authority.
Will trade directions for favors before resorting to threats.

records.name: Mrs. Wren
records.personality: Overly friendly neighbor who remembers everyone's childhood incorrectly.
secrets: Her memories change when challenged.
She knows where the Wrong Dogs gather at dusk.

records.name: Coach Danner
records.personality: Gruff, exhausted, speaks in clipped instructions.
secrets: Not the real coach; knows he is a reconstruction.
Can identify Locker 113 as an anomaly anchor.

records.name: Nadia Rook
records.personality: Suspicious, funny under pressure, aggressively practical.
secrets: Separated from her own party.
Saw a black service door near the Stadium road but could not open it.

records.name: Clerk Seven
records.personality: Emotionless retail cheerfulness with occasional terrified glitches.
secrets: Resets every time the station lights go out.
Can hand over the Pump Seven Token if crawlers break the loop without destroying the store.

records.name: Bucky Brown
records.personality: Enthusiastic to a medically concerning degree.
secrets: The mascot suit is empty.
Can guide crawlers toward the Stadium service tunnel if treated like a real person.

records.name: Wrong Dog

other_effects.text: On a Major Fail or worse, the target is knocked down.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! WRONG DOG. It is absolutely a dog. Stop looking at the elbows.

records.name: Porch Goblin

other_effects.text: May disengage toward nearby houses after landing a hit.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! PORCH GOBLIN. Home ownership was already a trap.

records.name: Cart Crawler

other_effects.text: If it moved before attacking, the GM may add environmental knockback.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! CART CRAWLER. Cleanup on aisle: you.

records.name: Hall Monitor

other_effects.text: Marks targets as OUT OF HALL PASS for encounter flavor.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! HALL MONITOR. Running is prohibited. Screaming is merely discouraged.

records.name: Pump Seven Attendant

other_effects.text: On a Major Fail or worse, target is splashed with volatile fuel until cleaned.

records.ai_announcement: NEIGHBORHOOD BOSS! PUMP SEVEN ATTENDANT. Please prepay inside.

records.name: Receipt Mannequin

other_effects.text: Attempts to drag targets toward storefront displays.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! RECEIPT MANNEQUIN. It has a generous return policy. For your skin.

records.name: The Wrong Coach

other_effects.text: May call one Hall Monitor reinforcement once per encounter.

records.ai_announcement: NEIGHBORHOOD BOSS! THE WRONG COACH. Everybody runs laps. Some people stop.

records.name: Black Key Warden

other_effects.text: Protects the Black Key and prioritizes anyone carrying anomaly evidence.

records.ai_announcement: BOROUGH BOSS! BLACK KEY WARDEN. You wanted the key. The key has opinions.

records.name: Bleacher Thing

other_effects.text: Can emerge from adjacent stadium seating as a reinforcement.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! BLEACHER THING. Please remain seated during your dismemberment.

records.name: Who's a Good Boy?
records.description: Go home. Discover why that was a terrible idea.
records.reward_notes: Pet Owner's Regret reward; Neighborhood Map if Cerberuff is defeated.
records.gm_end_goal: Force a personal confrontation with the reconstructed home, show how the System weaponizes familiar places, and resolve the Cerberuff threat.
records.retrieval_target: The memory-anchor clue inside the reconstructed home; no fixed physical form required.
records.triggered_encounter: Welcome Home (f1_e_rottpack) → Three Heads, One Collar (f1_e_cerberuff), boss Cerberuff.

records.name: The Town That Shouldn't Exist
records.description: Ms. Bell wants proof that the hometown replica is being assembled from corrupted personal data.
records.reward_notes: Unlocks the Black Key route and a Silver Adventurer Box.
records.gm_end_goal: Establish that False Brownwood is assembled from corrupted crawler memories and collect enough anomaly evidence to unlock the Black Door progression.
records.retrieval_target: Three anomaly evidence pieces: Pump Seven Token / gas-station evidence, Locker 113 school evidence, and an Impossible Receipt from the shopping district.
records.triggered_encounter: Pump Seven Closing Shift (f1_e_pumpboss), Final Bell (f1_e_coach), and Everything Must Go (f1_e_receipts) are the intended site encounters.

records.name: Pay at the Pump
records.description: Break the repeating gas-station loop without becoming part of the nightly inventory.

objectives.text: Survive or bypass the Pump Seven Attendant

records.reward_notes: Pump Seven Token; Bronze Utility Box.
records.gm_end_goal: Break the Pump Seven reset loop and recover its anomaly token as one piece of proof for The Town That Shouldn't Exist.
records.triggered_encounter: Pump Seven Closing Shift (f1_e_pumpboss) featuring the Pump Seven Attendant.

records.name: No Running in the Halls
records.description: Find the source of the school anomaly and get back out before the bell cycle completes.

objectives.text: Recover the locker key or bypass the lock
Confront the Wrong Coach or escape with the evidence

records.gm_end_goal: Reach Locker 113, recover the school anomaly evidence, and expose another corrupted memory anchor.
records.retrieval_target: Locker 113 evidence; the Locker 113 Key (f1_item_lockerkey) is a route tool, not necessarily the final evidence itself.
records.triggered_encounter: Final Bell (f1_e_coach) featuring The Wrong Coach; Passing Period (f1_e_halls) can precede it.

records.name: Proof of Purchase
records.description: The shopping district is printing receipts for memories. Find out whose.
records.reward_notes: Impossible Receipt evidence; Bronze Adventurer Box.
records.gm_end_goal: Prove the shopping district is manufacturing crawler memories and secure its anomaly evidence.
records.retrieval_target: Three Impossible Receipts, with at least one tied to a real crawler memory.
records.triggered_encounter: Everything Must Go (f1_e_receipts) featuring Receipt Mannequins.

records.name: The Black Door
records.description: Use the anomaly evidence to locate and open the service door leading toward the Stadium route.

objectives.text: Bring anomaly evidence to Ms. Bell

records.reward_notes: Access to Stadium route; Gold-tier campaign milestone reward at GM discretion.
records.gm_end_goal: Convert the three anomaly investigations into concrete progression: reveal the Black Door, acquire its key, and open the Stadium route.
records.retrieval_target: The Black Key (f1_item_blackkey), after presenting the anomaly evidence to Ms. Bell.
records.triggered_encounter: The Key Has a Warden (f1_e_warden) featuring the Black Key Warden.

records.name: Friday Night Forever
records.description: Cross the Stadium district and locate the route deeper into Floor One.

objectives.text: Reach the route marker beyond the field

records.reward_notes: Floor One progression; Silver Adventurer Box.
records.gm_end_goal: Move the party through the Stadium district and reveal the route deeper into Floor One.
records.retrieval_target: No retrieval target; the goal is reaching the service tunnel/route marker beyond the field.
records.triggered_encounter: Home Side Advantage (f1_e_bleachers) is the intended Stadium combat.

records.name: Missing Party
records.description: Nadia Rook is looking for the crawlers she entered with.

objectives.text: Choose whether to help her continue the search

records.reward_notes: Nadia becomes a friendly contact; Bronze Utility Box.
records.gm_end_goal: Turn Nadia Rook into a recurring friendly contact by resolving what happened to her separated party.
records.retrieval_target: Evidence identifying the route or fate of Nadia's missing party; exact form is left for GM placement.
records.triggered_encounter: No mandatory boss; use an appropriate local encounter if the search crosses a hostile district.

records.name: FIRST BLOOD
records.description: Deal the party's first confirmed kill inside The Homecoming.

records.name: OH. THAT HURTS.
records.description: Lose a Health Bar slot for the first time and remain standing.

records.name: WHO'S A GOOD BOY? NOT THAT.
records.description: Survive a Wrong Dog encounter after somebody insists it is probably friendly.

records.name: PROPERTY VALUES
records.description: Enter three false homes that definitely do not belong to you.

records.name: PAY INSIDE
records.description: Break the Pump Seven loop without destroying every fuel pump.

records.name: HALL PASS DENIED
records.description: Defeat or escape a Hall Monitor while carrying no valid hall pass.

records.name: KEEP THE RECEIPT
records.description: Recover an Impossible Receipt tied to a real crawler memory.

records.name: KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATOR
records.description: Acquire the Black Key.

records.name: HOMETOWN HERO
records.description: Complete the major Homecoming route with every active crawler alive.

records.name: CUSTOMER SERVICE VOICE
records.description: Resolve a hostile situation with a Floor One NPC without starting combat.

records.name: Homecoming Adventurer Box
records.contents: One useful low-floor tool or mundane gear item, one consumable, and one crawler-specific oddity selected by the GM.

records.name: Homecoming Utility Box
records.contents: A practical tool drawn from the Floor One item library plus a small situational consumable.

records.name: First Blood Box
records.contents: A low-floor weapon/tool upgrade or combat-useful consumable.

records.name: Pain Management Box
records.contents: Medical supplies, protective gear, or another survival-oriented item.

records.name: Pet Owner's Regret Box
records.contents: A Wrong Dog Whistle or another animal-control themed utility item.

records.name: Responsible Consumer Box
records.contents: A Silver utility/gear item associated with the Pump Seven anomaly.

records.name: Key Performance Box
records.contents: A Silver gear or utility reward themed around access, locks, or exploration.

records.name: Hometown Hero Box
records.contents: A meaningful Silver item tailored to the crawler who receives it.

records.name: Detention Box
records.contents: A school-themed tool, consumable, or low-floor gear reward.

records.name: Proof of Purchase Box
records.contents: A shopping-district utility item plus one unsettling personalized trinket.

records.name: Dusk on the Residential Loop

other_effects.text: On a Major Fail or worse, the target is knocked down.

records.system_announcement: The porch lights turn on. The dogs do not look happier about it.

objectives.text: Keep the route to the saferoom open

special_rules.text: Fences, parked cars, and porches provide changing lanes and obstacles.

records.name: Neighborhood Welcome Committee

other_effects.text: May disengage toward nearby houses after landing a hit.

records.system_announcement: Several residents wave. The things under their porches wave too.

special_rules.text: Useful as an early tutorial fight or grinding complication.

records.name: Aisle Be Seeing You

other_effects.text: If it moved before attacking, the GM may add environmental knockback.

records.system_announcement: Every shopping cart in the lot rotates toward the party at once.

objectives.text: Prevent the carts from isolating a crawler

special_rules.text: Moving carts can split the battlefield into lanes.

records.name: Passing Period

other_effects.text: Marks targets as OUT OF HALL PASS for encounter flavor.

records.system_announcement: The bell rings. Nobody has a hall pass.

special_rules.text: Doors lock and unlock as the bell cycle advances.

records.name: Pump Seven Closing Shift

other_effects.text: On a Major Fail or worse, target is splashed with volatile fuel until cleaned.

records.system_announcement: PUMP SEVEN IS NOW CLOSED FOR MAINTENANCE. YOU ARE THE MAINTENANCE.

objectives.text: Defeat or bypass the Pump Seven Attendant

special_rules.text: Fuel hazards should be telegraphed before they become dangerous.

records.name: Everything Must Go

other_effects.text: Attempts to drag targets toward storefront displays.

records.system_announcement: The mannequins turn their heads. The sale is apparently final.

special_rules.text: Store displays create cover and narrow aisles.

records.name: Final Bell

other_effects.text: May call one Hall Monitor reinforcement once per encounter.

records.system_announcement: COACH SAYS ONE MORE LAP. THE SYSTEM SAYS HE MEANS IT.

special_rules.text: The Wrong Coach can call one Hall Monitor reinforcement if the fight needs escalation.

records.name: The Key Has a Warden

other_effects.text: Protects the Black Key and prioritizes anyone carrying anomaly evidence.

records.system_announcement: The Black Key is hanging exactly where you can see it. Of course it is.

objectives.text: Defeat, trick, or bypass the Warden

special_rules.text: Designed as a major route encounter; allow noncombat solutions if earned.

records.name: Home Side Advantage

other_effects.text: Can emerge from adjacent stadium seating as a reinforcement.

records.system_announcement: The home crowd rises. Unfortunately, the home crowd is made of bleachers.

special_rules.text: Reinforcements can emerge from unused seating sections.

records.name: The Coliseum
records.summary: A familiar civic arena rebuilt as a torchlit Roman spectacle. The System treats voluntary combat as premium entertainment.
hazards: hostile crowd effects at GM discretion

records.name: Brown County Lockup
records.summary: A county jail stretched into a compact dungeon of cellblocks, booking desks, property storage, medical rooms, and sealed control stations.

records.name: Home, Sweet Home?
records.summary: A nearly perfect reconstruction of a crawler's home, except the dogs are enormous and the System has decided mythology improves pet ownership.

records.name: Memory Lanes
records.summary: A bowling alley reproduced with unnerving fidelity. The scoring system knows names, histories, and events it should not know.

records.name: Last Stand Sporting & Arms
records.summary: A gun store that looks like an arsenal until the System explains that most Earth firearms are mundane duplicate-function equipment.
reward_hooks: very limited ammunition at GM discretion

records.name: Cassius 'Cash' Mercer
records.personality: Showman, bookmaker, and relentless commentator who treats crawlers as both athletes and inventory.
secrets: Knows the Champion's arena can be manipulated through its gate controls.

records.name: Leon Pike
records.personality: Watchful, sardonic, and willing to barter information for freedom.
secrets: Remembers corridors that do not exist in the real jail.
Has seen System workers move anomaly evidence through booking.

records.name: Control Officer M-12
records.personality: Speaks entirely in calm policy language while trying to contain everyone.
secrets: Can be reasoned with if crawlers exploit contradictory detention rules.

records.name: Marlene 'Marty' Voss
records.personality: Warm, nostalgic, and increasingly distressed whenever the alley recalls something she was not programmed to know.
secrets: Knows the bowling alley is a memory anchor.
Can reveal a Homecoming clue after a completed game.

records.name: Range Safety Randy
records.personality: Treats every sentence like a mandatory safety briefing and every crawler like a liability waiver.
secrets: The System deliberately limits replacement firearms here.
Knows the security range contains a useful utility cache.

records.name: Cardboard Legionnaire

other_effects.text: Can form a shield line when adjacent to another Legionnaire.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! CARDBOARD LEGIONNAIRE. Rome wasn't built in a day. These were.

records.name: Net Goblin

other_effects.text: Carries a capture net; entangling effects are GM adjudicated.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! NET GOBLIN. Finally, social networking with consequences.

records.name: The Hometown Caesar

other_effects.text: Arena gates and hazards may change between rounds.

records.ai_announcement: NEIGHBORHOOD BOSS! THE HOMETOWN CAESAR. All roads lead to getting punched.

records.name: Cellblock Trustee

other_effects.text: Uses doors and cells to isolate targets.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! CELLBLOCK TRUSTEE. Time off for good behavior has been canceled.

records.name: Riot Control Deputy

other_effects.text: May shove targets away from control points.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! RIOT CONTROL DEPUTY. Please stop resisting the floor plan.

records.name: Oversized Rottweiler

other_effects.text: Pack behavior rewards surrounding isolated crawlers.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! OVERSIZED ROTTWEILER. Still thinks it fits in your lap.

records.name: Cerberuff, The Very Good Boy

other_effects.text: Familiar commands, treats, gates, and household knowledge may create noncombat openings at GM discretion.

records.ai_announcement: NEIGHBORHOOD BOSS! CERBERUFF, THE VERY GOOD BOY. THREE TIMES THE DROOL. THREE TIMES THE TRAUMA.

records.name: Pinsetter Gremlin

other_effects.text: Can retreat into lane machinery if not blocked.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! PINSETTER GREMLIN. Please keep hands clear of moving machinery.

records.name: Return-Rack Horror

other_effects.text: Deals its best damage after moving in a straight lane.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! RETURN-RACK HORROR. Your ball has returned. It brought friends.

records.name: Range Target Stalker

other_effects.text: Uses store aisles and range partitions as cover.

records.ai_announcement: NEW MOB! RANGE TARGET STALKER. Center mass is offended.

records.name: Arena Bracer
records.system_description: Leather-and-brass bracer stamped with a tiny thumbs-down icon.

mechanics.notes: +1 STR while equipped.

records.name: Plastic Victor's Laurels
records.system_description: Cheap plastic leaves with surprisingly real System authority.

mechanics.notes: +1 CHA while equipped.

records.name: County Riot Vest
records.system_description: Heavy protective vest recovered from jail storage.

mechanics.notes: Campaign protective gear; +1 CON while equipped.

records.name: Universal-ish Cuff Key
records.system_description: A tiny key labeled UNIVERSAL-ISH.

mechanics.notes: Useful against mundane restraints; does not override magical/System locks.

records.name: Sealed Property Bag
records.system_description: A clear county property bag with somebody else's inventory number.

mechanics.notes: Container and clue prop; contents chosen by GM.

records.name: Dungeon-Grade Dog Treats
records.system_description: A pouch of treats that smell distressingly good even to humans.

mechanics.notes: Campaign consumable that can influence canine encounters when fictionally appropriate.

records.name: Cerberuff's Spare Collar
records.system_description: A huge three-loop collar somehow resized by Inventory.

mechanics.notes: +1 CON while equipped.

records.name: League-Night Bowling Shoes
records.system_description: Rental shoes that never quite match but grip dungeon floors beautifully.

mechanics.notes: +1 DEX while equipped.

records.name: The House Ball
records.system_description: A sixteen-pound bowling ball with three finger holes and zero respect for toes.

mechanics.notes: Campaign thrown/improvised weapon; GM adjudicates unusual lane interactions.

records.name: Pro-Shop Wrist Guard
records.system_description: A stiff wrist brace from the pro shop.

mechanics.notes: +1 DEX while equipped.

records.name: Range Eye Protection
records.system_description: Impact-rated glasses with a faint System overlay.

mechanics.notes: +1 INT while equipped.

records.name: Reinforced Utility Sling
records.system_description: A rugged adjustable sling.

mechanics.notes: Firearm-adjacent utility gear. Does not improve firearm damage by itself.

records.name: Bottomless-ish Range Bag
records.system_description: A range bag that is much roomier inside than its zipper suggests.

mechanics.notes: Campaign container; no extra firearm granted.

records.name: Electronic Hearing Protection
records.system_description: Amplifies quiet sounds and cuts harsh reports.

mechanics.notes: Campaign sensory utility; +1 INT while equipped.

records.name: Bread and Circuses
records.description: The Coliseum wants volunteers. The definition of volunteer is deteriorating rapidly.

objectives.text: Defeat or outwit the Hometown Caesar

records.reward_notes: Silver Gladiator Box; Neighborhood Map if the Neighborhood Boss is defeated.
records.gm_end_goal: Give combat-hungry crawlers an optional arena gauntlet and a legitimate Neighborhood Boss/map reward path.
records.triggered_encounter: Opening Ceremonies (f1_e_arena1) → The Crowd Wants Blood (f1_e_arena2) → Hometown Caesar (f1_e_caesar), boss The Hometown Caesar.

records.name: Prison Break-In
records.description: Something useful is locked inside the county jail. Unfortunately, so is everything else.
records.reward_notes: County Utility Box and recovered jail property.
records.gm_end_goal: Turn the jail into a compact exploration dungeon where the party raids property storage and learns the System is moving anomaly material through civic infrastructure.
records.retrieval_target: Useful/confiscated property from secured storage; optional anomaly-transfer evidence in booking.

records.name: Perfect Game
records.description: Memory Lanes is offering one free game. The scoreboard has added several rules nobody remembers agreeing to.
records.reward_notes: League Night Box and a memory-anchor clue.
records.gm_end_goal: Reveal Memory Lanes as a strong memory anchor by making the party finish the System's corrupted bowling game and earn a clue about how Homecoming is built.
records.retrieval_target: A memory-anchor clue revealed by the scoreboard after the final frame.

records.name: Second Amendment to Your Expectations
records.description: Search the gun store for useful supplies after the System informs you that owning another mundane firearm would be redundant.
records.reward_notes: Range Utility Box; firearm-adjacent equipment; limited ammunition only if GM awards it.
records.gm_end_goal: Subvert the expectation that the gun store is a firearm upgrade cache; reward careful resource use with utility equipment instead.
records.retrieval_target: The security-range utility cache; contents are firearm-adjacent gear and only limited ammunition if the GM chooses.

records.name: ARE YOU NOT MILDLY ENTERTAINED?
records.description: Win a Coliseum bout while the System is actively scoring style.

records.name: ET TU, CRAWLER?
records.description: Defeat the Hometown Caesar.

records.name: TIME SERVED
records.description: Enter jail voluntarily and still manage to get locked in.

records.name: COMPLIANCE ISSUE
records.description: Defeat a Riot Control Deputy after being ordered to comply.

records.name: THERE'S NO PLACE LIKE HOME
records.description: Return to a reconstructed personal home and immediately regret it.

records.name: SIT. STAY. PLEASE.
records.description: Survive Cerberuff, The Very Good Boy.

records.name: TURKEY DINNER
records.description: Complete three consecutive successful bowling objectives during Perfect Game.

records.name: UNNECESSARY SPLIT
records.description: Use the bowling alley environment to defeat two threats in one sequence.

records.name: YOU ALREADY HAVE ONE
records.description: Enter the gun store expecting a better gun and leave without acquiring another firearm.

records.name: AMMO ECONOMY
records.description: Resolve a gun-store encounter without spending firearm ammunition.

records.name: Gladiator Participation Box
records.contents: Arena-themed low-floor gear or consumables.

records.name: Victor's Box
records.contents: A meaningful Silver arena reward; defeating the Neighborhood Boss also awards its RAW map reward.

records.name: County Property Box
records.contents: Utility gear, medical supplies, protective equipment, or weird confiscated property.

records.name: Compliance Box
records.contents: Protective or control-themed utility gear.

records.name: Homeowner's Box
records.contents: Household-survival gear plus one unsettling personalized item.

records.name: Obedience School Box
records.contents: Canine-themed Silver gear or utility reward; defeating the Neighborhood Boss also awards its RAW map reward.

records.name: League Night Box
records.contents: Bowling-themed gear, consumables, or memory-anchor oddities.

records.name: Pro Shop Box
records.contents: Bowling shoes, wrist gear, or another alley-themed utility item.

records.name: Range Utility Box
records.contents: Eye/ear protection, sling, range bag, flashlight, maintenance tools, or limited ammunition at GM discretion. No automatic firearm.

records.name: Resource Management Box
records.contents: Utility equipment that rewards solving problems without simply spending ammunition.

records.name: Opening Ceremonies

other_effects.text: Can form a shield line when adjacent to another Legionnaire.
Carries a capture net; entangling effects are GM adjudicated.

records.system_announcement: WELCOME TO THE GAMES. LIABILITY WAIVERS WERE IMPLIED.

special_rules.text: Arena gates create changing entry points.

records.name: The Crowd Wants Blood

other_effects.text: Can form a shield line when adjacent to another Legionnaire.
Carries a capture net; entangling effects are GM adjudicated.

records.system_announcement: THE AUDIENCE HAS VOTED. THEY WOULD LIKE YOU TO TRY HARDER.

objectives.text: Keep the party from being divided

special_rules.text: Moving barriers split the arena into temporary zones.

records.name: Hometown Caesar

other_effects.text: Arena gates and hazards may change between rounds.

records.system_announcement: CHAMPION EVENT! PLEASE APPLAUD UNTIL SOMEONE STOPS MOVING.

objectives.text: Defeat or outwit the Hometown Caesar

special_rules.text: Gate controls can be discovered and exploited.

records.name: Booking Procedure

other_effects.text: Uses doors and cells to isolate targets.
May shove targets away from control points.

records.system_announcement: WELCOME TO COUNTY. PERSONAL EFFECTS WILL BE RETURNED NEVER.

records.name: Facility Lockdown

other_effects.text: May shove targets away from control points.

records.system_announcement: LOCKDOWN IN EFFECT. THIS INCLUDES YOUR OPTIONS.

special_rules.text: Security doors change the battlefield each round at GM discretion.

other_effects.text: Pack behavior rewards surrounding isolated crawlers.

special_rules.text: Fences, gates, vehicles, and familiar yard features matter.

records.name: Three Heads, One Collar

other_effects.text: Familiar commands, treats, gates, and household knowledge may create noncombat openings at GM discretion.

records.system_announcement: NEIGHBORHOOD BOSS! CERBERUFF WOULD LIKE BELLY RUBS. THIS IS A TRAP. PROBABLY.

objectives.text: Reach the memory anchor inside the home

special_rules.text: Allow earned noncombat solutions using personal familiarity.

records.name: League Night

other_effects.text: Can retreat into lane machinery if not blocked.
